name: Hearth
direction: Mature chesty mezzo; light Jamaican English; broad, rolling warmth with an easy chuckle.
description: A mature adult woman with a rich chesty mezzo voice and a light Jamaican English accent. Broad rounded vowels, a relaxed rolling rhythm, and a smile that feels close and personal. A little husky warmth in the lower notes, clear consonants, and confident sentence endings. She can shift from easy amusement to calm authority. Natural conversational English. Clean studio recording.
text: The road is quiet this morning. Come inside, and tell me where you are going. We can find a place for your horses.
